root_cause_summary: employees/{empId} self-update denylist omitted explicitAttendanceDelegation, delegatedEmployeeIds, delegatedBranchIds, authorizedBranchIds, authorizedDepartmentIds, authorizedTeamIds, managerId, supervisorId while ServerAttendanceService.resolveTrustedActor read them from empData.
implemented_remediation: Restricted employees/{empId} self-update to strict profile allowlist + expanded explicit denylist; updated resolveTrustedActor to read delegation and scope arrays exclusively from server-protected users/{uid}.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Live Firestore Emulator execution BLOCKED_NO_JAVA; run @firebase/rules-unit-testing in JDK CI before deploy.

root_cause_summary: Direct client updates allowed self-targets to tamper with checkOut/realHours/status on attendance_logs/records/sessions/attendance and omit recordedBy/actorId.
implemented_remediation: Blocked all client create/update/delete (if false) on all 8 authoritative attendance collections; mandated recordedBy == request.auth.uid && actorId == request.auth.uid in canWriteAttendanceForEmployee; locked attendance_justifications create to status=='PENDING' and update to isTenantAdminOrManager.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Live Firestore Emulator execution BLOCKED_NO_JAVA; verify deny rules in emulator.

root_cause_summary: getBusinessId(data) prioritized camelCase businessId over business_id without enforcing tenant field equality.
implemented_remediation: Added hasConsistentTenantFields(data), made getBusinessId(data) return 'none' on cross-field conflicts, required canonical non-empty string business_id in canWriteAttendanceForEmployee, and rejected conflicting tenant fields in extractCanonicalBusinessId.

root_cause_summary: Firestore rules lacked payroll lock enforcement, permitting direct client SDK writes inside locked cycles.
implemented_remediation: Eliminated direct client SDK writes across all 8 authoritative attendance collections in firestore.rules so all attendance mutations execute via Admin SDK routes guarded by verifyPayrollPeriodUnlockedInTransaction.

root_cause_summary: 6 UI and repository workflows wrote directly to Firestore client SDK bypassing /api/attendance/* and ServerAttendanceService.
implemented_remediation: Removed direct Firestore attendance mutation fallbacks; threw MUTATION_BYPASS_DENIED on preferDirectFirestore; migrated overrides, recalculations, deletions, MyWorkspace clock-in/out, MassImportModal, EmployeeRepository.saveAttendanceLog, and adjustments to /api/attendance/*.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Dead setDoc import at MassImportModal.tsx:25 (unused); offlineSync queues locally when offline and enforces live Firebase Auth sync.

root_cause_summary: HEAD_TELLER with explicitAttendanceDelegation=true and empty branch set received tenant-wide access; rules and backend delegation checks diverged.
implemented_remediation: Updated hasExplicitTellerDelegation to fail closed when actorBranches.size === 0 or !targetBranchId unless explicitly in delegatedEmployeeIds or delegatedBranchIds; aligned firestore.rules helpers with branch/delegated arrays.

root_cause_summary: verifyScannedBadgeSecurity bypassed signature comparison when signature was empty; ServerAttendanceService skipped badge check on method='QR' if badge fields were omitted and picked docs[0] on duplicate active badges.
implemented_remediation: Required cryptographic signature/tokenHash match whenever activeBadge exists or requireSignature===true; enforced mandatory signature verification on server for QR/NFC methods and rejected multiple ACTIVE badges with 409 AMBIGUOUS_ACTIVE_BADGES.
residual_risk_and_next_step: EmployeeRepository.createEmployee (lines 600-622) still emits legacy btoa signature on onboarding badge create; server checks against persisted employee_badges doc.

root_cause_summary: createAdjustmentRequest/approveAdjustmentRequest wrote directly to Firestore without Maker-Checker separation, approval RBAC, canonical business_id, or attendance_records sync, while rules allowed SUPERVISOR update.
implemented_remediation: Added server endpoints /api/attendance/adjustments and /api/attendance/adjustments/approve enforcing OWNER/MANAGER RBAC, Maker-Checker (requester != approver -> 403 MAKER_CHECKER_VIOLATION), replay guard (409 ADJUSTMENT_ALREADY_PROCESSED), transactional payroll lock, canonical business_id, and synchronized attendance_sessions/logs/records/events/audit_logs; disabled client writes in rules.

root_cause_summary: audit_logs were written outside runTransaction inside try/catch { console.warn }, allowing state changes without forensic audit records.
implemented_remediation: Moved audit_logs writes into recordAuditEventInTransaction inside adminDb.runTransaction with no try/catch swallowing so audit failures roll back attendance mutations.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Pre-authorization denial audit events still log best-effort before throwing 403/401, which does not mutate attendance state.

root_cause_summary: Payroll period lock ran outside runTransaction (TOCTOU) and queried only snake_case business_id.
implemented_remediation: Moved verification inside runTransaction via verifyPayrollPeriodUnlockedInTransaction querying both business_id and businessId and failing closed on DB errors or missing cycle dates; updated client verifyPeriodLock to dual-query with 5s cache.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Client verifyPeriodLock remains an advisory pre-check; authoritative lock enforcement occurs transactionally on the server.

root_cause_summary: Stale prior-day ACTIVE sessions became stranded; checkOutWithAdmin read status outside txn and cleared activeSessionId unconditionally; no idempotencyKey support.
implemented_remediation: Auto-flags prior-day unclosed ACTIVE sessions to FLAGGED in checkInWithAdmin; verifies activeSessionId === sessionId inside checkOutWithAdmin transaction before clearing; rejects overrideTimestamp <= checkInTs; enforces attendance_idempotency replay & conflict detection.
residual_risk_and_next_step: attendance_idempotency records do not auto-expire via Firestore TTL unless configured in GCP console.

root_cause_summary: Missing apiResp.session silently fell back to direct Firestore; offlineSync hardcoded actor={id:employeeId,role:'EMPLOYEE'} and branchId='UNKNOWN'; attendance_status lacked client update prohibition.
implemented_remediation: Removed direct Firestore fallback completely; required live authenticated operator in offlineSync (actorId === sessionActorUid, preserving branchId, badge fields, idempotencyKey); blocked client writes on attendance_status in firestore.rules.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Offline records queued by one operator cannot be synced by a different logged-in user (fails closed with PERMISSION_ERROR).

root_cause_summary: Hardcoded 'e1'/'e2'/'admin_sys' forensic userId fallbacks and uncontrolled useEffect date auto-repair performing client setDoc/deleteDoc.
implemented_remediation: Replaced all hardcoded forensic fallbacks with auth.currentUser?.uid / resolvedActorId; removed uncontrolled date auto-repair useEffect from AttendanceLedger.tsx.
regression_tests: PROVEN_STATIC inspection + grep verification (0 legacy literals/direct Firestore writes in AttendanceLedger)
residual_risk_and_next_step: Duplicate QR validation call flow remains between AttendanceLedger.tsx and useQRScanner.ts, though both delegate to shared verifyScannedBadgeSecurity & authorizeAttendanceAction.

root_cause_summary: role.permissions.ts omitted teller/auditor roles; PermissionRepository granted override_attendance to SUPERVISOR and HEAD_TELLER; TEAM_LEADER attribution differed.
implemented_remediation: Unified capability matrix across all 3 client RBAC modules + server domain: explicit entries for all teller/supervisor/auditor roles, stripped override_attendance/attendance.override/attendance.approve from non-management roles.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Dynamic Firestore custom role overrides remain filtered by sanitizeDynamicPermissions (repositories/index.ts:370-376).

root_cause_summary: No JDK/Java installed in verification container (which java -> NO_JAVA); rule tests use regex assertions and in-memory Maps.
implemented_remediation: Documented explicit BLOCKED_NO_JAVA status without fabricating runtime emulator results.
residual_risk_and_next_step: Must run @firebase/rules-unit-testing against Firestore Emulator in JDK-enabled environment before deploying firestore.rules.
